name: Pop In
description: The second clip pops in as a rounded card over the first, with an elastic overshoot: too big, a bit small, then it settles into the full frame as its corners square off. Drive `progress` from 0 to 1.

inputs.name: second
inputs.description: Incoming clip (same size as the first)

params.name: center
params.description: Point of the frame the second clip pops from (0..1, y down)

params.name: bounce
params.description: How far the card overshoots (too big, then a bit small) before it settles

params.name: corner
params.description: Corner radius of the card while it pops, relative to its shorter side

params.name: shadow
params.description: Darkness of the drop shadow the card casts on the first clip
